title: Persuasive Writing
description: Type a persuasive paragraph. Practice varied vocabulary.

exercises.instruction: Everyone should learn to save drinking water. Clean water is a precious gift. When we close the tap and fix small leaks, we protect rivers and lakes for the future. Small actions create a big difference.
